title: sse: fix streaming chunking/framing for partial JSON, delimiter and token ordering edge cases
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Fix: SSE streaming framing and chunking edge cases that caused partial JSON tokens and delimiter mis-ordering to produce invalid partial events. No API contract changes.
description: Motivation: Streaming (SSE) responses occasionally emitted malformed partial JSON fragments or mis-ordered delimiter events under load and during function/tool-calling flows. Symptoms included: clients receiving partial JSON tokens that could not be reassembled, unexpected ordering between 'data:' events and delimiters which broke OpenAI-compatible clients, and rare cases where KV-cache flushing produced empty chunk events. This PR: 1) introduces a deterministic chunk buffer for building SSE payloads that preserves token order across multi-part responses and function/tool call boundaries; 2) standardizes delimiter emission order so 'data: [partial]' events are always followed by delimiter markers in the agreed sequence for OpenAI-compat consumers; 3) adds strict partial-JSON stitch logic that emits an explicit "__partial__" marker in debug builds (disabled in prod) and falls back to safe newline-terminated fragments for clients that cannot handle streaming partial tokens; 4) fixes a race in the KV-cache flush path that could inject empty SSE events; 5) adds comprehensive unit and integration tests covering partial JSON reassembly, tool-calling sequences, and edge-case ordering under batching. This change is backwards-compatible with existing API semantics and is gated behind an opt-in feature flag (sse_stable_streaming) for rollout. See linked Linear tickets for the perf/regression evaluation plan.

review_comments: Michael Chen: LGTM overall. Two nits: can you add a short comment in streamer.go explaining why we switch to newline-terminated fallback for legacy clients? Also please ensure the opt-in flag defaults to false.
Asha Patel: Good points. Added comment and verified flag defaults to false. Also added an explicit test asserting flag default and opt-in behavior.
Riley Thompson: Found a rare ordering failure in the stress harness when batching > 16 requests; suggested adding a sequence-number assertion during debug builds.
Asha Patel: Added debug sequence-number assertions behind a build tag and updated the stress harness to run with smaller batch sizes in CI to keep runs stable while still catching regressions.
Samir Gupta: Can we add a short migration note in release notes explaining that some very old clients that assumed delimiter order reversal may need testing? Approving with that addition.
Asha Patel: Added release note blurb and confirmation that no customer-facing contract changes are made. Thanks!

merge_outcome: merged via squash by Michael Chen on 2025-01-22. Merge message summarises deterministic chunking, delimiter ordering, and kv-cache flush fix. Opt-in feature flag set to false by default for staged rollout.
notes: Rollout plan: enable sse_stable_streaming for internal canary, then enable for Dedicated customers with opt-in, followed by org-wide toggle if no regressions after 2 weeks. Monitoring: add alert if error-rate for streaming clients increases post-rollout. Backout: flip feature flag off if regressions occur.
